children: The S&P Global France Composite PMI rose to 51.2 in September 2026 from 48.5 in August and better than market forecasts of 48.7, flash estimates showed.
The data showed the country's private sector returning to expansion at its strongest pace in more than two years, bringing an end to a sustained period of contraction since the start of the year.
The upturn was led by a rebound in services, where activity expanded at its fastest pace in seven months.
Meanwhile, manufacturing output growth slowed and remained marginal.

title: French Private Sector Performs Better than Expected
